Project Tracker OS · Reference card 2/7

Statuses, WIP & ownership

v1.4.0-docs.1
target template v1.4.0
One page for the five statuses, the one-task WIP rule, and who owns what. Full detail: HOW TO USE §2, §5.2, §17.

Statuses

StatusMeaningSet when
TodoReady, not startedDoR incomplete or work not picked
In ProgressOwner is workingDoR passes; check-in posted
In ReviewReady for reviewPR + evidence attached
BlockedCannot proceedConcrete reason + dependency linked
DoneAccepted and evidencedCheck-out posted; issue closed

Allowed transitions

From → ToEntry conditionEvidence
Todo → In ProgressDoR passes, owner + branchCheck-in comment
In Progress → In ReviewImplementation readyPR/evidence
In Review → In ProgressChanges requestedReview comment
In Progress → BlockedConcrete blockerBlocker comment + blocked-by
Blocked → In ProgressBlocker clearedUnblock note
In Review → DoneAccepted + evidencedCheck-out comment
Done → Todo/In ProgressRegression or follow-upComment + plan-change if scope

WIP = 1

  • One In Progress task per owner (human or agent identity).
  • A second In Progress task is a violation unless a dated plan-change documents the exception and timebox.
  • Finish, block, or defer before starting another task; audit flags WIP violations.

Ownership

RoleResponsible forNot responsible for
OwnerCheck-in/out, status, evidenceSilent scope growth
Executor (human/agent)Doing the work under the ownerSelf-merging without evidence
ReviewerAcceptance, evidence, qualityRewriting history
MaintainerTriage, sprint/release close, tokensBypassing security rules

One owner identity per task. If a human delegates to an agent, record Owner: and Executor: separately in the check-in.

Blocked and plan changes

  • Blocked needs reason + dependency link + impact + unblock condition; post the blocker template.
  • Plan change: dated plan-change comment (old → new, why) + label + sprint/release/Project field updates + defer equivalent scope. Never rewrite history.

Status is authoritative

The Project Status field drives the board; comments and labels are context, not state. Do not use status:blocked as a status. Keep one source of truth.
